subject: MAP: handoff checklist and sandbox usage terms for evaluation deliverables
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lighthousehealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: jamie.liao@lighthousehealth.com, legal@lighthousehealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exchange of eval assets & sandbox terms (initial ask)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo last week — we liked the latency profile and the tokenizer compatibility. As discussed, we'd like to move forward with a 3-week evaluation where Redwood runs a seeded test set against our clinical summarization prompts.

Before we hand over any material, our InfoSec and compliance teams need confirmation on the following:
- A short mutual action plan (timeline + acceptance criteria) for the trial.
- Explicit usage constraints for the sample records and prompt packs (ephemeral, no retention beyond test window, no external sharing).
- A sandbox access form for any hosted test environments and a contact for data deletion requests.

I attached a small seed package (anonymized excerpts) to start the intake. Can you confirm next steps and an initial MAP draft we can sign off on?

Best,
Ellen Park
Director, Clinical Innovation
Lighthouse Health

---

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval assets & sandbox terms (initial ask)

Hi Ellen — thanks for the seed package and clear asks.

High-level next steps I propose:
1) Redwood shares a 1-page MAP (timeline, roles, acceptance criteria) by EOD tomorrow.
2) LH shares any legal redlines to the MAP (we keep it minimal — scope, retention, permitted use).
3) Once MAP is agreed, we provision a private sandbox project and issue temporary credentials.
4) LH uploads the full prompt pack + labeled testcases to the sandbox; Redwood runs two runs (baseline & tuned) and shares metrics and sample outputs.

Key constraints we will uphold:
- All uploaded evaluation materials and prompt packs will be stored only in the provisioned sandbox and retained for the trial window plus 48 hours for teardown.
- No material will be used to train models or improve Redwood's models outside the isolated evaluation run.
- Outputs derived from LH material will be shared only with LH and its reviewers.

I attached a first-pass MAP draft and a sandbox access form. Marcus will lead the run and Vivek will coordinate the infra and data deletion flow.

Would you be able to review the MAP and return any redlines by Wednesday EOD (18 Nov)?

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): MAP_Draft_LH-Redwood_v1.docx; Sandbox_Access_Form.pdf

---

From: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@lighthousehealth.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: ellen.park@lighthousehealth.com, legal@lighthousehealth.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval assets & sandbox terms (initial ask)

Sofia — quick note from our InfoSec: the retention wording needs to be precise. We can agree to the 48-hour post-trial retention for active debugging, but we need a guaranteed scriptable deletion and an export log. Also confirm that sandbox credentials will be single-tenant and IP-restricted to our office ranges.

If you can add a short clause about deletion confirmation (signed by Redwood infra lead), we can probably turn the MAP around fast.

Thanks,
Jamie
Principal PM, Data & AI
Lighthouse Health

---

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@lighthousehealth.com>, sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exchange of eval assets & sandbox terms (initial ask)

Thanks Jamie — noted and reasonable. Quick technical confirmations:
- Sandbox will be provisioned as a private project (single-tenant) in the us-west region. We will apply an IP allowlist that matches the CIDR you provide.
- Data deletion will run via an infra teardown script that:
  * revokes credentials,
  * deletes object storage containers associated with the project, and
  * clears all inference caches and KV stores.
- After teardown, we will provide a GZipped deletion manifest with MD5 checksums and timestamps. The manifest will be signed electronically by our infra lead (Vivek).

I will update the MAP doc with an explicit deletion clause and a short acceptance checklist (metrics: ROUGE-L >= 0.72 baseline improvement target; privacy: no PHI in retained artifacts).

Marcus Lin
Lead Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

---

From: legal@lighthousehealth.com
To: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com, ellen.park@lighthousehealth.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft redlines

Sofia, Marcus — our counsel had two short redlines:
1) Narrow permitted use language to: "evaluation runs only; no model tuning or productization with LH data."
2) Add a 30-day escrow hold for audit artifacts (deletion manifest accessible to LH legal).

We don't expect pushback; if you can accept those, we can sign.

Regards,
Teresa Gomez
Senior Counsel, Lighthouse Health

---

From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@lighthousehealth.com>, Jamie Liao <jamie.liao@lighthousehealth.com>, legal@lighthousehealth.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: handoff checklist and sandbox usage terms for evaluation deliverables

Ellen/Jamie/Teresa — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've accepted the two redlines in the MAP and added the deletion manifest workflow to the sandbox form.

Next operational steps (per signed MAP):
- Monday 23 Nov: Redwood provisions the private sandbox and opens a ticket with credentials and IP allowlist instructions.
- Tues 24 Nov: Lighthouse uploads full prompt pack and labeled testcases (we will validate format and checksum).
- Wed 25 Nov - Fri 27 Nov: Redwood runs baseline and tuned evaluations, shares metrics dashboard and 10 sample outputs.
- Mon 30 Nov: Joint review sync and acceptance decision. If acceptance criteria met, we will discuss a 90-day pilot contract.

Attachments for your records: MAP_Draft_LH-Redwood_v1.docx (redlined accepted); Sandbox_Access_Form.pdf; Lighthouse_eval_seed_v1.zip (initial artifacts you shared).

I'll follow up with the provisioning ticket on Monday. Marcus will be the run owner and Vivek will sign the deletion manifest when teardown completes.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): MAP_Draft_LH-Redwood_v1.docx; Sandbox_Access_Form.pdf; Lighthouse_eval_seed_v1.zip
